text:
Vogue Williams hasn't disclosed the baby's name(Image: Dave Benett, Jed Cullen/Dave Benett/Getty Images for Disney+)

Vogue Williams is expecting her fourth child with husband Spencer Matthews - and it appears the name could be quite memorable.

During a conversation with friend Joanne McNally on their My Therapist Ghosted Me podcast, Vogue, 40, cautioned that her upcoming baby's name was "mad." Vogue jokingly told Joanne, "I'm just going to warn everyone, the name we love is f----d, OK? It's mad."

Describing her fourth child's name as the "heaviest hitter" yet, she continued, "It's such a big first name. We're going to do a normal middle name just in case. So the baby can choose." It comes as Vogue pushed back against the "upsetting" divorce rumors she and Spencer have been subjected to.

The baby's name remains undisclosed for now, though Vogue shared that Joanne "flinched" upon first hearing it. Joanne confessed, "I was a bit taken aback... the screaming was a bit much, but I, I apologize for that."

Vogue noted she was accustomed to distinctive names, having lived with one herself, reports the Irish Mirror. She recalled, "I remember once [Spencer's] dad, this is no joke, actually said 'What's her middle name? Would she mind going by that?'"

Vogue and Joanne McNally pictured together at Wimbledon(Image: Instagram/voguewilliams)

She mentioned knowing she was "bringing the Matthews family name down" with a "cheapo" name like Vogue. Joanne suggested that Vogue could carry her name simply due to her appearance, "As I've always said, you're lucky you're attractive, because if you weren't, you'd be a big figure of irony."

She mentioned that given the name Vogue was considering, the new baby would need to be "at least an eight out of 10" to carry it off. She clarified, however, that she was only "half teasing" Vogue and that the undisclosed name was actually very cool. It's probable, though, that the public won't discover Vogue's intriguing secret until later this year.

Vogue is running slightly behind her original timeline, having previously stated, "We want to have four kids before I'm 40." Her fourth child is anticipated to arrive sometime this fall, placing her nearly a year off track.

Vogue, pictured with Spencer Matthews, has shut down divorce rumors(Image: Justin Goff Photos, Getty Images)

But circumstances were vastly different in 2016 when at 31 years old, she was navigating a divorce from her first husband, Westlife star Brian McFadden. She revealed at the time that she had largely accepted the possibility that motherhood might never happen for her.

Vogue shared with the Sunday Times, "I had wanted to be married with kids at 30, not divorced and single. I felt: 'Well, that's ruined my whole life. That's it. I'm never going to meet anyone. I'm never going to have kids.'"

However, in January 2018 Vogue revealed that she was engaged to Made In Chelsea star Spencer Matthews. It was a whirlwind romance as the pair wed in June 2018 and welcomed their first child, Theodore, that same year.

Gigi arrived in 2020 and Otto two years afterward. Vogue and Spencer shared news of her pregnancy with their fourth baby in April this year.
